dedupe_keys.name: 2020 census demographic and housing characteristics file dhc and related 2020 census data products

description: The Demographic and Housing Characteristics File (DHC) is the main detailed product of the 2020 Census, the U.S. Census Bureau's constitutionally mandated count of every resident on 1 April 2020. It contains age, sex, race, Hispanic origin, household and family type, relationship, group quarters population, housing occupancy and tenure, with many tables available down to the census block. The same 2020 Census family includes the Demographic Profile (to tract), the Detailed DHC-A and DHC-B (about 1,500 detailed race and ethnic groups and tribes, to tract), the Supplemental DHC, congressional district summary files, the Privacy-Protected Microdata File and the Island Areas censuses of American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Coverage: the 50 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico; DHC and Demographic Profile released 25 May 2023, Detailed DHC-B on 1 August 2024. Access: data.census.gov, FTP summary files and the Census Data API (free key); free and public domain. Earlier censuses (2010 Summary File 1 and older) remain available. Caveats: the 2020 Census used differential privacy, so the Bureau advises aggregating small populations and geographies; block-level figures other than total population and housing units can be implausible. Simulation uses: block-level population and housing unit baselines for hazard exposure, service-area demand, evacuation and shelter planning, and for calibrating synthetic populations. Related records: the P.L. 94-171 redistricting data (the first 2020 block-level release), ACS tables, TIGER/Line block and boundary layers, and population estimates that carry the census forward.
